note: v481: Two paychecks on the same payday can be recorded together. Tap ⋯ → Paycheck on either deposit and the other same-day deposits are listed with tick boxes — tick the ones that are part of that payday, watch the running total, and one tap records the combined amount and clears both bank lines. The Budget tab tracks one amount per payday, so both go in as that payday's total.
